thread:
nora: onboarding vendor 'Atlas' returning mixed failures: SCIM POST 400 MissingAttribute(role) and periodic KMS decrypt errors for ext_id. opening thread.
isabel: any timing or recent infra changes?
nora: Started ~09:22 UTC. Dev-bot shows repeated scim.create failures with MissingAttribute(role). Also a few decrypt errors: "KMS decrypt failed: unknown-envelope-version"
sre: Pulling a SAML assertion sample from Atlas. I see Attribute elements present but prefixed with 'a:' and the Name fields look ok (urn:redwood:attr:role). Eg: <a:Attribute Name="urn:redwood:attr:role"><a:AttributeValue>dev</a:AttributeValue></a:Attribute>.
isabel: We must not rely on prefixes; parser should resolve namespace URI. Could be a templating lib change at their side.
vendor-integ: Atlas confirmed they upgraded template engine and changed namespace prefixes; they also attempted to standardize envelopes with a new in-house KMS wrapper.
nora: Immediate mitigation: enable tenant-level namespace-relaxed parsing for Atlas while we fix parser. Dev-bot can toggle.
dev-bot: executing: /ops tenant-config atlas scim.ns_relax=true --expires 8h
sre: After enabling, MissingAttribute failures dropped from 25 -> 2 in 10m. KMS decrypt errors still need partner fix.
isabel: For KMS, we should reject unsupported envelopes with 400 and clear guidance (do not accept silently). Add audit entry including raw header for SOC correlation. Open SEC-5010 for validator + SEC-5011 for improved error messaging.
vendor-integ: Atlas will rewrap ext_id using our documented 'redwood-kms-v1' and resend payloads within 3 hours.
nora: Action items: (1) isabel: add strict envelope validator + helpful 400 (SEC-5010); (2) sre: implement namespace-resolution fix + tests (SEC-5012); (3) vendor-integ: coordinate Atlas resend and confirm.
dev-bot: [09:48] scim.create succeeded user=atlas/emma req=req_a9f3 note=extid-wrapped-ok
 nora: marking monitor and will schedule postmortem notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
